description: Search the UK Companies House register, fetch company profiles, list officers, or download filing history. No API key or login is required.

apiKey.description: Optional free key from developer.company-information.service.gov.uk. It adds structured addresses, jurisdiction, and overdue flags. Without a key the actor uses the public website and still returns companies, officers, and filings.
apiKey.title: Companies House API Key (optional)

companyNumbers.description: Registration numbers or Companies House profile links, e.g. ['00445790'] or ['https://find-and-update.company-information.service.gov.uk/company/00445790']. Used by the three lookup modes.
companyNumbers.title: Company Numbers or Profile URLs

companyStatus.description: Limit search results to one register status. Leave as All statuses to include every status.
companyStatus.title: Company Status Filter

companyType.description: Limit search results to one legal form. Leave as All types to include every form.
enumTitles: Private limited by guarantee without share capital
Private unlimited company without share capital
Further education or sixth form college corporation
companyType.title: Company Type Filter

dissolvedFrom.description: Earliest dissolution date (YYYY-MM-DD). Companies House only shows dissolutions since 2010.
dissolvedFrom.title: Dissolved From

filingCategory.description: In filing-history mode, limit records to one category. Leave as All filings to return everything.
filingCategory.title: Filing Category

maxItems.description: Maximum number of company, officer, or filing records to return across all supplied company numbers.
maxItems.title: Max Items

mode.description: What to collect: search results, full company profiles, officers, or filing history.
enumTitles: Search companies by name or filter
Get company profile by number or URL
mode.title: Mode

officerStatus.description: In officers mode, return all appointments, only current officers, or only resigned officers.
officerStatus.title: Officer Status

registeredOfficeAddress.description: Filter by all or part of a registered office address, e.g. 'Welwyn Garden City' or 'Cardiff'.
registeredOfficeAddress.title: Registered Office Location

searchQuery.description: Company name or keyword to search for, e.g. 'Tesco', 'consulting', or 'renewable energy'.
searchQuery.title: Company Name or Keywords

sicCode.description: Filter by one 5-digit Standard Industrial Classification code, e.g. '62012' for computer programming.
sicCode.title: SIC Code

title: Companies House Scraper Input
